result.final:
Yes. An American citizen needs a work visa to take a healthcare job in the UK for more than six months. The relevant route may be the Health and Care Worker visa, which requires an eligible role, a job offer from a Home Office approved UK employer, a certificate of sponsorship, and the required salary. A Standard Visitor stay is usually limited to six months and does not allow ordinary paid or unpaid work for a UK company.

Official sources: [Health and Care Worker visa](https://www.gov.uk/health-care-worker-visa) · [Standard Visitor rules](https://www.gov.uk/standard-visitor)
